args.code:
do
 local function verifyEphemeralSeed(player, world, storage)
  assert(world and world:GetAttribute('PersistenceMode')=='EphemeralStudio','fixture requires an ephemeral Studio world')
  assert(world:GetAttribute('PersistenceStudioDefaultEphemeral')==true and world:GetAttribute('PersistenceStudioLiveDataOptIn')==false,'world allows live profile access')
  assert(storage:GetAttribute('PunchWallAllowLiveDataStoreAccess')~=true,'ServerStorage opts into live data')
  assert(player and player:GetAttribute('ProfileReady')==true and player:GetAttribute('ProfilePersistenceState')=='EphemeralStudio' and player:GetAttribute('ProfileWritable')==false,'fixture requires a ready nonwritable ephemeral player')
  return true
 end
 assert(game:GetService('RunService'):IsStudio(),'combat QA is Studio-only')
 local players=game:GetService('Players'):GetPlayers() assert(#players==1,'combat QA requires exactly one isolated player')
 verifyEphemeralSeed(players[1],workspace:FindFirstChild('PunchWallRPG'),game:GetService('ServerStorage'))
end

local function selectStoneFixture(folder, G)
 local best
 local center=(G.DepthWall.Columns+1)/2
 for _,b in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
  if b:IsA('BasePart') and b:GetAttribute('IsDepthBlock')==true and b:GetAttribute('Tier')==2 and b:GetAttribute('MaterialTier')==2 and b:GetAttribute('MaxHP')==G.Walls[2].hp and b:GetAttribute('Row')==1 and not b:GetAttribute('Broken') then
   local depth=b:GetAttribute('Depth') local column=b:GetAttribute('Column')
   assert(type(depth)=='number' and type(column)=='number','missing real block coordinates')
   if not best or depth<best:GetAttribute('Depth') or (depth==best:GetAttribute('Depth') and (math.abs(column-center)<math.abs(best:GetAttribute('Column')-center) or (math.abs(column-center)==math.abs(best:GetAttribute('Column')-center) and b.Name<best.Name))) then best=b end
  end
 end
 assert(best and best:GetAttribute('MaxHP')==900 and best:GetAttribute('HP')==900 and best.Anchored and best.CanCollide and best.CanQuery,'intact actual 900 HP stone required')
 assert(typeof(best:GetAttribute('BaseCFrame'))=='CFrame' and (best.Position-best:GetAttribute('BaseCFrame').Position).Magnitude<.01,'stone must occupy its actual grid cell')
 return best
end
local function isApproachBlock(b, target)
 return b:IsA('BasePart') and b:GetAttribute('IsDepthBlock')==true and b:GetAttribute('Depth')<target:GetAttribute('Depth') and b:GetAttribute('Depth')>=target:GetAttribute('Depth')-3 and math.abs(b:GetAttribute('Column')-target:GetAttribute('Column'))<=1 and b:GetAttribute('Row')>=1 and b:GetAttribute('Row')<=3
end
local function approachPosition(target, rootPart, humanoid, floor)
 local legHeight=humanoid.RigType==Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 and 2 or 0
 local standingY=floor.Position.Y+floor.Size.Y*.5+humanoid.HipHeight+rootPart.Size.Y*.5+legHeight
 return Vector3.new(target.Position.X,standingY,target.Position.Z+target.Size.Z*2)
end
local function restoreRadialFixture(storage, world, player)
 local token=world:GetAttribute('RadialStoneFixtureToken')
 if token==nil then return true end
 assert(type(token)=='string','invalid owned fixture token')
 local holding=storage:FindFirstChild('RadialStoneFixture_'..token)
 assert(holding and holding:GetAttribute('FixtureKind')=='RadialStoneApproachV1' and holding:GetAttribute('OwnerUserId')==player.UserId,'refuse foreign fixture')
 local folder=world:FindFirstChild('Depth Blocks') assert(folder,'missing original depth parent')
 local ref=holding:FindFirstChild('OriginalRoot') local rootPart=ref and ref.Value
 local originalCharacter=rootPart and player.Character and rootPart.Parent==player.Character
 -- Move the original avatar out before restoring corridor collision. No anchoring or humanoid state changes.
 if originalCharacter then
  rootPart.CFrame=holding:GetAttribute('OriginalRootCFrame')
  rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity=holding:GetAttribute('OriginalLinearVelocity')
  rootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity=holding:GetAttribute('OriginalAngularVelocity')
 end
 local restored=0
 for _,b in ipairs(holding:GetChildren()) do
  if b:IsA('BasePart') then
   assert(b:GetAttribute('IsDepthBlock')==true and not folder:FindFirstChild(b.Name),'ambiguous held block')
   b.Parent=folder restored+=1
  end
 end
 assert(#folder:GetChildren()==holding:GetAttribute('OriginalDepthCount'),'exact depth instance count not restored')
 holding:Destroy() world:SetAttribute('RadialStoneFixtureToken',nil)
 assert(originalCharacter,'original character changed; corridor restored without moving a replacement')
 return true
end

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local storage=game:GetService('ServerStorage') local world=workspace.PunchWallRPG
local c=storage.PunchWallAutomation local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1]
assert(world:GetAttribute('RadialStoneFixtureToken')==nil,'previous fixture must be restored first')
c:Invoke('Reset') c:Invoke('SetStats',{Power=100,WallLevel=3,CritChance=0,FistMultiplier=1,PetMultiplier=0,FistMastery=1,Rebirths=0,HonorPowerBonus=0})
local G=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig) local folder=world['Depth Blocks']
local target=selectStoneFixture(folder,G) local character=p.Character local rootPart=character.HumanoidRootPart local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
assert(humanoid and humanoid.Health>0 and not rootPart.Anchored,'real living unanchored character required')
local floor=world:FindFirstChild('Depth Corridor Floor',true) assert(floor and floor:IsA('BasePart') and floor.CanCollide,'existing corridor floor required')
local position=approachPosition(target,rootPart,humanoid,floor)
local held={}
for _,b in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do if isApproachBlock(b,target) then table.insert(held,{part=b,parent=b.Parent,cf=b.CFrame,anchored=b.Anchored,collide=b.CanCollide,query=b.CanQuery,touch=b.CanTouch,attrs=b:GetAttributes()}) end end
assert(#held>0 and #held<=27,'approach scope must be at most three columns, rows and preceding layers')
local token=H:GenerateGUID(false) local holding=Instance.new('Folder') holding.Name='RadialStoneFixture_'..token
holding:SetAttribute('FixtureKind','RadialStoneApproachV1') holding:SetAttribute('OwnerUserId',p.UserId)
holding:SetAttribute('OriginalRootCFrame',rootPart.CFrame) holding:SetAttribute('OriginalLinearVelocity',rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity) holding:SetAttribute('OriginalAngularVelocity',rootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity)
holding:SetAttribute('OriginalDepthCount',#folder:GetChildren())
local ref=Instance.new('ObjectValue') ref.Name='OriginalRoot' ref.Value=rootPart ref.Parent=holding
holding.Parent=storage world:SetAttribute('RadialStoneFixtureToken',token)
local function pose(v) return {x=v.X,y=v.Y,z=v.Z} end
local out={ok=false,exactDamage=false,fixtureRestored=false,selectedTarget=false,expectedTarget=target.Name,expectedTier=target:GetAttribute('Tier'),expectedMaterialTier=target:GetAttribute('MaterialTier'),expectedMaxHP=target:GetAttribute('MaxHP'),targetPosition=pose(target.Position),targetSize=pose(target.Size),clearedCount=#held}
local successful,failure=xpcall(function()
 for _,record in ipairs(held) do record.part.Parent=holding end
 rootPart.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(position,position+Vector3.new(0,0,-1)) rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero rootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero
 local boundsCF,boundsSize=character:GetBoundingBox()
 local overlap=OverlapParams.new() overlap.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include overlap.FilterDescendantsInstances={folder} overlap.MaxParts=0
 local blocking=0 for _,b in ipairs(workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(boundsCF,boundsSize,overlap)) do if b.CanCollide and not b:GetAttribute('Broken') then blocking+=1 end end
 out.approachBlocking=blocking out.poseBefore=pose(rootPart.Position)
 out.beforeTarget=boundsCF.Position.Z-boundsSize.Z*.5>target.Position.Z+target.Size.Z*.5
 assert(blocking==0 and out.beforeTarget,'approach must start clear and before the actual target face')
 p:SetAttribute('DamageBoostExpiresAt',0)
 local expectedHP=G.Walls[2].hp-G.EffectivePower(100,1,0,0,1,0)
 local r=c:Invoke('PunchRadius')
 out.poseAfter=pose(rootPart.Position) out.rootTravel=(rootPart.Position-position).Magnitude
 local b=folder:FindFirstChild(tostring(r.primary))
 out.ok=r.ok out.primary=r.primary out.selectedTarget=b==target
 if b then out.tier=b:GetAttribute('Tier') out.materialTier=b:GetAttribute('MaterialTier') out.shakeToken=b:GetAttribute('ShakeToken') out.lastShakeAt=b:GetAttribute('LastShakeAt') out.survived=not b:GetAttribute('Broken') out.hp=b:GetAttribute('HP') out.maxHP=b:GetAttribute('MaxHP') out.exactDamage=math.abs(b:GetAttribute('HP')-expectedHP)<1e-6 end
end,function(err) return tostring(err) end)
-- Retain the last real pose and target state even if Invoke raises before returning its result.
out.poseAfter=out.poseAfter or pose(rootPart.Position)
out.observedPrimary=tostring(p:GetAttribute('LastRadiusPrimary') or 'none')
out.targetAfterHP=target:GetAttribute('HP') out.targetAfterTier=target:GetAttribute('Tier')
local restored,restoreError=pcall(restoreRadialFixture,storage,world,p)
if restored then
 for _,record in ipairs(held) do
  local b=record.part local same=b.Parent==record.parent and b.CFrame==record.cf and b.Anchored==record.anchored and b.CanCollide==record.collide and b.CanQuery==record.query and b.CanTouch==record.touch
  local attrs=b:GetAttributes() for k,v in pairs(record.attrs) do same=same and attrs[k]==v end for k,v in pairs(attrs) do same=same and record.attrs[k]==v end
  restored=restored and same
 end
end
out.fixtureRestored=restored and world:GetAttribute('RadialStoneFixtureToken')==nil
if not successful then out.ok=false out.error=string.sub(tostring(failure),1,280) end
if not restored then out.ok=false out.restoreError=string.sub(tostring(restoreError or 'original block state differs'),1,280) end
return H:JSONEncode(out)
